summary: Master cyber law, GDPR, and NIST frameworks. Learn to manage digital risk and online governance in this 5-day professional course. Enroll today.
lede: Cyber law covers the legal and governance issues that arise from digital activity. Designed for professionals working across technology, law, and corporate risk, the course addresses how to assess digital liability and guide governance decisions. Practical work includes conducting privacy impact assessments, creating cybersecurity governance scorecards, drafting digital service agreements, and preparing evidence preservation and regulatory disclosure processes.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for professionals responsible for the intersection of technology, law, and corporate risk management.
modules: Intellectual Property in the Digital Age
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of corporate governance or IT management. Familiarity with basic data privacy concepts is recommended. No prior legal degree is required, as the course focuses on practitioner-level application of cyber law frameworks.
